component.name: Linxira Recovery Diagnostics
component.summary: Inspect recovery readiness and create repair plans

description.p: Read-only diagnostics for Btrfs, Timeshift, package recovery, boot files, and live-system chroot readiness.
The application executes two fixed read-only checks through root-owned plans and receipts, and creates reviewable repair plans and privacy-filtered local support bundles. It does not apply repairs.
